Ellen P: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2031 — pattern: KV cache cold-miss cascade when burst traffic hits a single shard. We need the runbook to be explicit: quick mitigations, exact debug commands, and escalation path. Who takes each section?

Jae K: I can do the quick mitigations + commands. Will write a short "first 10 minutes" checklist (restart, check warm metrics, flush if needed). ETA 3 business days.

Marcus L: For the playbook please include a non-destructive KV sanity check before flushing. Example: `curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_warm_count` and `curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | jq .kv_status` so operators don't accidentally cold-start everything.

Priya S: Add a temporary circuit-breaker rule: if 5xx rate > 2% AND cold_start_rate increases 3x in 1m -> auto-scale by +2 pods and lower max batch_size to 16. I'll open an infra ticket.

QA Zoe: I'll add a staging smoke test that injects a small burst and asserts kv_hit_rate >= 90% within 30s. That should catch regressions before deploy.

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-ups for INC-2031 are due in tracker by 2026-04-01.

Ellen P: Outline of playbook sections I'm asking for:
- Immediate triage (who to page, quick checks, safe commands)
- Short-term mitigation (config toggles, scaling steps, rollback)
- Long-term fixes (pre-warm service, shard balancing, observability adds)

Jae K: Commands I'll add to triage: 
```
# watch pod logs across replicas for kv errors
stern inference-runtime -n inference --since 5m | grep -i kv_cache
# check metrics for warm/cold ratios
curl -s http://$POD:9100/metrics | egrep "kv_hit_rate|cold_start_count"
# graceful restart of a replica (drain then restart)
kubectl -n inference cordon $NODE && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```
Also I'll include a safety note: prefer scale-up before flush.

Marcus L: For escalation, my suggestion:
- Severity P1 if p95 latency > 2.5s OR 5xx rate > 5% for 2m -> page oncall primary.
- If no ack in 4m, auto page secondary and DM infra-leads.
- If incident persists past 30m escalate to Eng Ops director.
I'll add exact Slack play message and who to cc.

Priya S: Ticket created for circuit-breaker and alert rules: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2031-CB. ETA for alert rollout: 2026-03-28.

Ellen P: Action items (capture here so tracker aligns):
- Triage checklist + commands: Jae K — due 2026-03-25, PR to runbooks repo.
- Safe KV sanity checks + metrics pages: Marcus L — due 2026-03-24, will add grafana panels.
- Circuit-breaker & alert rules: Priya S — ticket INC-2031-CB, due 2026-03-28.
- Staging burst smoke test: QA Zoe — due 2026-03-22, will attach results to ticket.
- Long-term pre-warm design doc: Ellen P & Eng-ML — draft by 2026-04-10.

Jae K: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/102 — includes first-10-min checklist and commands. Feedback welcome.

Marcus L: Grafana panels PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/observability/pulls/47.

QA Zoe: Staging smoke results linked: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/67321/artifacts/kv-burst-smoke.txt — passed with kv_hit_rate stabilizing at 92% after 25s on avg.

Ellen P: Nice work. Let's try to close the short-term items this cycle. If anyone needs help splitting tasks ping here or DM. We'll update the incident tracker (INC-2031) with owners/ETA and close the follow-up checklist when PRs/alerts are merged. :white_check_mark:
